description: This file contains utility classes and functions for partitioning neural network graphs, including classes for partitions, devices, latencies, and functions for calculating memory sizes, latencies, and communication costs between partitions.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Represents a graph partition with nodes, parent/child relationships, and memory info.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device with a name, available memory, and logical ID.

classes.name: NodeLatency
classes.description: Stores latency metrics for a node, including memory and compute latency.

classes.name: PartitionLatency
classes.description: Stores overall latency metrics for a partition, including critical path latency.

classes.name: PartitionMode
classes.description: Enumeration of partitioning modes: size-based, sparse neural network, cost-aware, KL-based, AOT-based.

classes.name: PartitionerConfig
classes.description: Configuration for the partitioner, including devices, mode, transfer rate, latency mappings, and host saturation.

methods.name: get_extra_size_of
methods.description: Calculates the extra memory size needed if a node is included in a set of nodes.

methods.name: get_latency_of_one_partition
methods.description: Computes the critical path latency of a given partition based on node latencies.

methods.name: get_partition_to_latency_mapping
methods.description: Maps each partition to its overall latency.

methods.name: get_comm_latency_between
methods.description: Calculates communication latency between two partitions based on shared input nodes and transfer rate.

methods.name: get_latency_of_partitioned_graph
methods.description: Determines the overall latency of a graph by finding the critical path among partitions.
